title: Reduce signed Hadamard lowering from 222 to 208 primitives (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

An explicit signed Hadamard connector uses 208 primitive calls, saving 14 against Cinna Davis's cited 222-call construction in #1158. Claim type: exact finite construction with a scoped algebraic proof for arbitrary exact linear maps and arbitrary dirty inputs.

```diff
- source queries: 8;  readouts: 16; primitive calls: 222; echo nodes: 66
+ source queries: 10; readouts: 12; primitive calls: 208; echo nodes: 62
  dirty scratch rows: 4
```

Two extra restoring calls on the cheapest source replace four first-output readouts. This deliberately leaves #1158's exactly-eight-source-call class. Its optimum is cited, not audited. The ten-source word, coefficient proof, complete child lowering and standalone verifier are in `research/hadamard-extra-source/README.md` and `verify.py`. No unrestricted optimum or new kappa is claimed.

The complete bill is `208E+62D+22Q+P_new+R_new`. Against the cited comparator, the reduction survives when the additional preparation/layout bill is less than `14E+4D+2Q`. No physical overhead is assumed zero.

## Evidence

Local CPython 3.12.15 checks pass:

- Exact formal endpoint for all 22 queries and all 208 primitive leaves with independent noncommuting symbols, including every source, initial output and dirty scratch input.
- 104 dense matrix input cases and 104 complete literal inverse replays; 25 missing-call, target-sign and alias rejection controls.
- Both registered normal/optimized commands; each direct command took about 0.06–0.07 seconds. The registered metadata/pin and replay wrapper passed.
- Committed bytes and complete source-history preflight at `ce08fe61d030b27da74c367cf4f9da537a3ddd06`.
- Official five-file export integrity and declared-input check; normal and optimized replay from the read-only export. Generated stdout receipts bind every package file by SHA256.

Exact reproduction, from the repository root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/hadamard-extra-source/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -O -B research/hadamard-extra-source/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/hadamard-extra-source
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/hadamard-extra-source --check-source-history
```

Another CPython 3.12 installation may replace the displayed interpreter. Expected markers: `PASS_HADAMARD_EXTRA_SOURCE`, `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`, `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES`. Only the standard library is needed. The verifier has no predecessor runtime dependency.

## Limitations

This is an exact linear connector with fixed A lengths `(2,3,4,5)` and B lengths `(1,2,3,4)`. It does not supply rounded children, physical routing, a current caller, stock/precision bounds, supplier admission or a complete multiplication theorem. Lean, Docker and the selected scientific replay were not run. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed. The selected frontier is unchanged.

## Open next questions

- What is the least weighted query price with arbitrary restoring source multiplicities? Start with this explicit upper bound and prove a lower bound that charges each source separately. A bounded sample does not settle that question.
- Can a named physical caller keep the saving after complete preparation, routing and precision costs? Compare its additional P+R bill with `14E+4D+2Q`.

## Related open work

- #3909 studies five-source all-mask connectors with atomic arity-four source events; this construction uses four signed Hadamard targets and only singleton source events.
- #3897 studies fused joint-output dispatch for two binary targets; every output readout here is separately charged, including the repeated call.
- #4079 studies seven-source bounded-weight binary coverage; the source count, signed target and complete price contract differ.
- #5935 studies connected restored source-XOR words; sources here remain read-only and only the dirty connector changes.

- #5948 supplies a Boolean fanout Pareto frontier for demand `(1,2,4)`; it does not study this signed Hadamard target or compute its primitive count.

The closeout refresh read all ten other open contributions from this account created since the advance CLAIM. None studies this fixed four-source signed Hadamard target or supplies a competing primitive count. Those searches do not cover unpublished work or every historical code diff. No additional computations were run to validate other contributions.

Their source bytes and credit are unchanged. New material is Apache-2.0.

[Advance claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19220061). Base: canonical main `19fdb086ea96af9a9f87936a2b888e10af4ed810`, priority revision 8. TASK.json explicitly changes the larger/nonabelian BIT card to this historical recursive-interface side result. The first verified improvement was retained and the search stopped.

## CI notes

Both hosted checks passed at exact head `ce08fe61d030b27da74c367cf4f9da537a3ddd06` in [run 40530418680](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/40530418680): [plan](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/40530418680/job/122281360650) in 5m2s and [registered package replay](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/40530418680/job/122284393610) in 1m54s. The completed checks were read once. The replay executes the registered normal and optimized commands. This certifies the bounded automated checks, not independent human or formal proof-kernel acceptance of the mathematical argument.

## Merge danger

Reversible archive-only addition confined to one new research directory. No shared executable, selected record or predecessor package is changed.
